# flydubai Careers

> flydubai's official careers portal offering aviation job opportunities across pilot, cabin crew, engineering, and support roles in the Middle East.

flydubai is a UAE-based airline operating a modern fleet of Boeing aircraft (737 and 787 Dreamliner) from Dubai International Airport. The careers site provides recruitment information, job listings, relocation guidance, and specialized programs for UAE nationals and students seeking aviation industry opportunities.

## Key Topics

- flydubai
- Dubai careers
- Aviation careers
- Pilot positions

## Job Opportunities

- [flydubai Job Search - Jobs](https://careers.flydubai.com/jobs): flydubai job listings and search portal for all positions
- [Pilot Vacancies](https://careers.flydubai.com/pilots): Pilot job vacancies including captain and first officer positions
- [Cabin Crew Vacancies](https://careers.flydubai.com/cabin-crew): Cabin crew job vacancies with requirements and application process
- [Engineering Vacancies](https://careers.flydubai.com/engineering): Aircraft maintenance and engineering career opportunities at flydubai
- [Behind the Scenes Vacancies](https://careers.flydubai.com/behind-the-scenes): Support team vacancies in customer experience, planning, procurement

## Specialized Programs

- [UAE National Opportunities](https://careers.flydubai.com/uae-national-opportunities): Career opportunities for UAE nationals including pilot cadet programme
- [Masar Internship Programme - flydubai](https://careers.flydubai.com/masarinternship): Masar internship programme for students in aviation industry

## Company Information

- [flydubai Careers Site](https://careers.flydubai.com): flydubai careers homepage with aviation job opportunities
- [About flydubai Careers Site](https://careers.flydubai.com/about-flydubai): About flydubai: airline overview, fleet, and recruitment process
- [Discover Dubai | flydubai career website](https://careers.flydubai.com/discover-dubai): Dubai relocation guide and expat lifestyle information for employees

- [Privacy Policy](https://careers.flydubai.com/privacy-policy): Privacy policy and data protection compliance information
